Data Collection Tool, but they cannot submit the APR. Editors can also view and print

the APR.

plain_text:
Multiple users may have access to the Data Collection Tool. If multiple users are entering data
on the same page of the APR at the same time, only the most recent data entry updates will be
captured by the system. If, however, multiple users are working on different pages within the
Data Collection Tool at the same time, one user's save will not overwrite the other's. Users
should work internally to ensure multiple users are not saving updates to the APR concurrently.
